title: Three realization problems about univariate polynomials
summary: We consider three realization problems about monic real univariate polynomials without vanishing coefficients. Such a polynomial $P:=\sum_{j=0}^db_jx^j$ defines the sign pattern $σ(P):=({\rm sgn}(b_d)$, $\ldots$, ${\rm sgn}(b_0))$. The numbers $p_d$ and $n_d$ of positive and negative roots of $P$ (counted with multiplicity) satisfy the Descartes' rule of signs. Problem~1 asks for which couples $C$ of the form (sign pattern $σ$, pair $(p_d,n_d)$ compatible with $σ$ in the sense of Descartes' rule of signs), there exist polynomials $P$ defining these couples.
